query: insert into suppressions (id, workspace_id, scope, email, email_hmac, reason, source, list_id, list_name) select $1, $2, 'list', $3, $4, 'unsubscribed_list', 'preference_center', l.id, l.name from lists l where l.workspace_id = $2 and l.id = $5 on conflict (workspace_id, scope, email_hmac, domain, list_name) where lifted_at is null do update set list_id = excluded.list_id
